Base Appearance

General

New
The wisdom of the realm cannot be discussed without my Clan.
Cookie Info & Loading
I would not recommend discounting me just for lacking brute force. Can you read what the tea leaves are telling you?
Within my formation, the battlefield might as well be within my tea cup. Life is short... so should it not be written that much more meticulously?
What would you say to a cup of fragrant tea? The gifted and talented gather in the Tea Clan's domain.
The perfect formation is one undetected by your foes. Your every move is already worked into my calculations.
I am fine.
I'm used to this much pai—COUGH!!! 		A single teapot contains the principles of this very universe...
Tired

Lobby

Daily Reward
It has been a pleasure talking with you.
Tap
The tea's aroma... It is ready. Take a seat. Learn how to savor a tea's aroma. Only then... will you understand what the tea is telling you.
I prepared these tea leaves myself early this morning. I am glad the tea is to your liking. Allow me to show you around the Tea Clan... *Cough...* Allow me to catch my breath...
This teapot is more than a mere tool. Its shape, its warmth... All are part of a well-calculated formation. Oh, this? Merely a chair for mobility... For Cookies who may have trouble getting around... *Cough!*
Sharing conversation over tea is much like a charged competition between each party's wits. My dough's weakness... Simply means I must make the most of each moment I have.
No need to be surprised. This was not a prediction, but the result of carefully leading you to make this choice. There is more than meets the eye. The moment you rely on what's seen, you are bound to lose your way.
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Marvels of the Tea Clan Lobby Do not touch a thing if you value your dough... There are traps set up everywhere.
When placed in a Lobby with Nimbus Cake Cookie or  Mantle of the Skyborne Clan I'd like to properly duel him some day. I wish to watch his prideful face be stripped of its air of ease.
When placed in a Lobby with Xiaolongbao Cookie or  General of the Scalding Tide Put me down this instant. I will not stop with words next time.
Gift
Neutral You've wasted my time. Not the choice I would have made...
Given Young Tea Leaf Fan Did I lose consciousness...?

I... I am fine. No need for concern.

Given Royal Golden Dough Aah... It resembles a tea steeped with only the freshest, most golden of tea leaves.

Cookie Trials

Trial Info
*Cough...* It appears... I pushed myself too hard. What brings you to the Tea Clean?
Can you see through this formation? The fragrance of tea calms my heart.
Stay on guard. There are traps everywhere... You wish to learn to read the flow of the universe?
New Cookie Cup End
I shall lend my wisdom where there is a will to use it.

 Alliance's Grand Strategist

General

Cookie Info & Loading
The Tea Clan's gardens appear tranquil... But is that truly the case? The gifted and talented gather in the Tea Clan's domain.*
I would not recommend discounting me just for lacking brute force.* This single glass of tea could change your fate.
Whether there is a next time... Depends on you alone. Hmm... Is the tea to your favor today?
What would you say to a cup of fragrant tea?* Your every move is already worked into my calculations.*
Not just any Cookie is worthy of sharing tea with us here. Can you read what the tea leaves are telling you?*

Lobby

Daily Reward
That was a valuable conversation. I shall be keeping my eyes on you.
Tap
No need to go through the trouble of trying to win my favor... I prefer things simple. Savor your tea. If you cannot understand its depth, you are not qualified to sit here.
Was your journey easy? This pavilion... is my favorite place within our tea gardens. You wish to know why I've called you here? I believe that is for you to prove for yourself.
You are well versed in recognizing the depth of a tea's flavor and aroma. I look forward to our conversation. You navigated the mechanisms and formations quite well to have reached this pavilion...
*Cough...* Excuse me a moment... Talking this much has run down my energy... How about you prepare the tea? I shall be watching... very closely.
The position of Grand Strategist is lonely... However, it is bearable so long as this warm glass lays in my hand. What sets you apart from the other countless Cookies out there? Well? I'm waiting.
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Marvels of the Tea Clan Lobby If you are in search of a Cookie who has mastered the astronomical principles and technology, you are in the right place.
When placed in a Lobby with  Mantle of the Skyborne Clan If you wish to utilize my strategy, you must first prove you're worthy of it.
When placed in a Lobby with  General of the Scalding Tide Just how spicy will you be getting? Though... I must say, sometimes I envy your brute strength.
Gift
Neutral *Cough... COUGH...!* I... I appreciate the thought...
Given Young Tea Leaf Fan This clears my mind. I believe we can continue our conversation.
Given Royal Golden Dough Are you attempting to pay for your Longjing Tea...? I assure you, it is quite priceless...
